_note: Per-building details read from openly licensed photos (Wikimedia Commons / Geograph, see photo-credits.json). 'at' is a point inside the outline in game metres. 'src' lists the photo ids used. No photo pixels are used in the game. 'pois' adds named places missing from the map data. The Starkie Arms exterior and interior also follow photos supplied by the site owner. The business centre, the leisure centre, the corner shop on Church Street and the Jaipur shop front follow reference pictures supplied by the site owner on 11 November 2026; their positions were pinned from Food Standards Agency food hygiene register geocodes and the OpenStreetMap node for Jaipur.
